u8: card load or save in progress. Set to 1 when a slot is chosen in the load screen (0x2195a8) or the save screen (0x218ba4, 0x218c18); cleared at boot (0x2170dc), when the load screen is opened (0x217760), when the loaded level has been entered or the load ends in an error (0x219810, 0x219884, 0x219a18) and when the "saved" box of a clean save closes (0x2190d0); NOT cleared by the save screen's card-error exit. While 1: mainloop_loadRequestedWorld skips the act-change clearing (0x320fb4), jumpgate_resetDestinations does nothing (0x27db10), the level change skips Camera_reset (0x322dc4). gxref lists only three of the stores

Savepoint_run sends game message 5 and clears it when it finds it set (0x28ce28-0x28ce3c); also read by frontend_start, playerSel_task and lobby_task

u8: 1 while a save, config save or end-game save is between its first card operation and its last screen; the main loop waits for 0 before a net level change (0x322cf4); memcard_abort does nothing while it is set (0x2185b4)
u8: save_clearBuffer skips the clear when non-zero (0x21f14c); the only writer stores 0 (0x1375dc), so it is always 0

(slot, isNew): only in a lobby game; packs the record with player_packRecord and hands the saved copy to the lobby library (0x380f08 for an existing character, 0x380888 with name, class, level and stat strings for a new one). Inferred: stores the character on the lobby service
(levelName): looks the level up with save_findAct; when it belongs to another act than the current one, sets the act and returns 1
